description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Area 10-foot burst within range

Rather than targeting one creature, a Verse you cast affects every creature in a 10-foot burst. Each attempts its own saving throw against the Verse separately. The Verse costs 1 additional Miasma, and if that draw takes you past your pool the Choir takes its toll as usual. Verses that do not target creatures are unaffected by this feat.

cinderfall.incomplete: Miasma is this class's focus-pool-that-doesn't-refill-on-rest resource. No SpecialResource rule element exists for it anywhere in the corpus: the class card itself (classes.plaguesworn.json:49) ships system.rules: [], and grep -rl "SpecialResource" site/data/cards/feats/class/plaguesworn/ site/data/cards/classes/classes.plaguesworn.json returns zero hits. Any clause that costs, refills, or banks Miasma is unbuildable via the renew:false mechanism -- that mechanism simply isn't wired up for this class. Independently, no rule element retargets a spell's target/area fields from single-creature to burst at cast time -- searched ItemAlteration's property list (area-size only rescales an existing area value, it doesn't convert a single-target spell into an area spell) and found nothing else that fits.
